about.heading: About Us
about.body: Welcome to Stratigi360, a beacon of innovation and efficiency in the world of business setup services where we redefine the process of establishing your business, making it seamless and stress-free. Our commitment to transparency, efficiency, and personalized service sets us apart.
about.body2: Specializing in a range of vital services, including business consultations, setup, legal & tax consultations, operations consultation, collateral building, marketing management, digital solutions, virtual assistance (BPO/KPO), and investment & financial consultations, we are your one-stop solution for comprehensive business support.

steps.title: Book a Free Consultation with Our Advisor
steps.description: Schedule a meeting, whether in person or via Zoom, with our business setup advisors. It's helpful to have a grasp of your business activities, shareholder count, target clientele, and office space needs. Don't worry if you need guidance: our team is prepared to assist in polishing up your business plan.

steps.title: Choosing the Right Jurisdiction
steps.description: We're here to help you pick the perfect location for your company, customized to match your specific needs and target audience. Whether you're aiming for maximum operational flexibility in the Mainland, seeking specialized industry perks in a Free Zone, looking for cost-effective solutions, or even eyeing the thriving business environment from any corner of the globe with an offshore setup, we've got you covered.

steps.title: Trade License Application
steps.description: Get your paperwork game strong! We'll help you prep all the necessary registration documents — think Application Form, Memorandum of Association, Certificate of Incorporation, Bank and Residency Statements, and whatever else you might need to set up your business. Different licenses and places mean different requirements, but our team will be by your side, guiding you through the entire process.

steps.title: Opening a Corporate Bank Account
steps.description: Having a corporate bank account is a must for doing business across the globe. There are various options for local, global, and digital banks to suit your financial needs. Our expert team will work with you to figure out the perfect bank match and get all the necessary documents ready for smooth submission.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about setting up your business with Stratigi360.

items.question: Can foreign entrepreneurs set up businesses in Dubai?
items.answer: Absolutely. Dubai is one of the most welcoming business environments for foreign entrepreneurs, with over 80% of its residents being expatriates. Foreign nationals can own 100% of their business in free zones and, with recent regulatory updates, in many mainland sectors as well.

items.question: How long does the business setup process take?
items.answer: Timelines can range from a few days to several months depending on the business type, jurisdiction, and documentation requirements. With Stratigi360's streamlined processes and expert team, we significantly reduce setup times compared to managing the process independently.

items.question: What types of businesses can be set up in Dubai?
items.answer: A wide range of business activities are eligible, including real estate, e-commerce, beauty and fitness, employment agencies, trading companies, cleaning services, technology firms, consulting businesses, and many more. We help identify the right license type for your specific activity.

items.question: How much does business setup in Dubai cost?
items.answer: Costs vary depending on the business type, chosen jurisdiction (mainland vs free zone), number of visas required, and specific licensing requirements. Stratigi360 provides a transparent cost breakdown through our Cost Calculator tool — giving you a clear picture before you commit.
